# Kestrel Bay Freight - control room

Counter closing times are booked at each hub against its own local clock.
The Glasgow control room logs closures as minutes after midnight UTC.

turns.prompt: Kestrel Bay Freight closes the Brisbane counter at 22:45 local time. The Glasgow control room logs counter closures as minutes after midnight UTC. What does the control room log for the Brisbane counter? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
